is_anopheles.evidence: Studies Anopheles gambiae s.l. (specifically An. coluzzii and An. gambiae s.s., page 1, 3-4).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Examines Vgsc L1014F (kdr 1014F) across molecular forms and time periods (page 4-5, Figure 2B).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: In the main text, kdr 1014F data is only presented as an aggregated summary bar plot of mean frequencies across pooled study sites (Figure 2B, page 4-5). Specific per-population genotype or allele counts/frequencies are compiled into Additional file 2d and not extractable from the provided paper.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from field sites across Côte d'Ivoire (pages 2-4).

is_primary_study.evidence: The paper is classified and structured as a review/meta-analysis synthesizing 22 years of historical bioassay and literature data (page 1, 3). The kdr L1014F data analysed is re-analysed from previously published studies (e.g. Chandre et al. 1999 [13], etc., page 5).

sub_country_location.evidence: Collection sites across four ecozones in Côte d'Ivoire are mapped and discussed (page 3, Figure 1; page 4).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Data are collated across specific years from 1993 to 2014, with periods like 1998 vs 2004-2012 distinguished (page 4-5).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study is a systematic review and re-analysis of data compiled from 52 published materials, 1 MSc thesis, and the AvecNet programme (page 3, 5).

supplement.evidence: 'molecular resistance diagnostic data for the kdr L1014F polymorphism (Additional file 2d)' and 'Prevalence of insecticide resistance... (Additional file 1)' (page 3, 5, 9).

assessment.summary: This article is a review and spatio-temporal meta-analysis of 22 years of insecticide resistance bioassay and kdr data in Anopheles gambiae s.l. from Côte d'Ivoire. Because the target marker data is re-analysed from previously published studies and individual population-level genotype counts/frequencies are not presented in the main text (relegated to supplementary files), it is not eligible as a primary study.
exclusion_reasons: Review / meta-analysis re-analysing previously published genotype data (not a primary study).
No extractable population-level genotype/allele counts or frequencies in the main text.
